channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Mo Bamba | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Mo Bamba from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Darko Rajakovic on Mo Bamba
item.description:
Rajakovic on Mo Bamba:

“I think this is a good opportunity for him to prove to everybody that he belongs in this league. We're going to have a very clear plan for him. We're going to give him an opportunity to show what he can do and hopefully it works for both sides.”

Darko Rajakovic on Mo Bamba, Dec 29, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Khem Birch on Mo Bamba
item.description:
More @Orlando Magic CKhem Birch on adding playing time he'll get with Mo Bamba out:

“I’ve been preparing myself all season - even when I didn’t play, I’d prepare myself as if I was going to play. Now, it’s just about getting back into rhythm and game shape and I’ll be fine.”

Khem Birch on Mo Bamba, Feb 5, 2019. Source: Twitter @JohnDenton555.

item.title: Steve Clifford on Mo Bamba
item.description:
More @Orlando Magic coachSteve Clifford on his plan for Mo Bamba:

“This isn’t going to be something where (Bamba) is just sitting. Learning the league and learning the how it works– there are always different ways that you can get better and stay engaged.”

Steve Clifford on Mo Bamba, Feb 5, 2019. Source: Twitter @JohnDenton555.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Mo Bamba
item.description:
Dwain Price:Carlisle on Orlando rookie Mo Bamba:

“I really enjoyed talking to him about basketball and I stayed in touch with him all the way up to the draft,because I felt there was a chance that we were going to take him.”

Rick Carlisle on Mo Bamba, Dec 10, 2018. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Nikola Vucevic on Mo Bamba
item.description:
.@OrlandoMagic C Nikola Vucevic on being a mentor to Mo Bamba:

“He’s my teammate and I’m obviously going to help him and he’s a really good person. He’s willing to listen and willing to learn and when you see something like that I’m obviously willing to help.”

Nikola Vucevic on Mo Bamba, Sep 28, 2018. Source: Twitter @JohnDenton555.

item.title: Nikola Vucevic on Mo Bamba
item.description:
More @Orlando Magic C Nikola Vucevic on mentoring Mo Bamba:

“I could have gotten upset, but I didn’t see a purpose in to doing that. I know my value and how valuable I am to this team and I know what I’ve done throughout my career.”

Nikola Vucevic on Mo Bamba, Sep 28, 2018. Source: Twitter @JohnDenton555.

item.title: Nikola Vucevic on Mo Bamba
item.description:
.@OrlandoMagic C Nik Vucevic on Mo Bamba:

“I’ve never had any reasons to think (Bamba’s addition) was gonna affect me. I’m going to do my job to the best of my ability and help Mo. He’s obviously a great talent and if he can help our team, I want to help him.”

Nikola Vucevic on Mo Bamba, Sep 28, 2018. Source: Twitter @JohnDenton555.

item.title: Jeff Weltman on Mo Bamba
item.description:
Jeff Weltman, after the draft, on selecting Mohamed Bamba:

“We are elated to get Mo Bamba. We jumped through the roof when he was available and we look forward to a very bright future with Mo.”

Jeff Weltman on Mo Bamba, Jun 22, 2018. Source: Twitter @JoshuaBRobbins.
